description: Use this when the user asks when autumn leaves peak, whether one city colors earlier than another, or wants a national overview for October-December. Returns city-level maple and ginkgo forecast dates, forecast maps, and regional commentary from Japan Meteorological Corporation. Do not use this for specific temples, gardens, or GPS-tagged locations; call koyo_spots next for those.

region.description: Optional case-insensitive filter for a region, prefecture, or city such as 'Kyoto', 'Tokyo', 'Hokkaido', 'Kansai'. Use this when the user only cares about one part of Japan instead of the full national forecast.
region.title: Region or Prefecture Filter

tree_type.description: Optional tree filter. Use 'maple' for momiji-only dates, 'ginkgo' for ginkgo-only dates, or omit/use 'all' to return both.
tree_type.title: Tree Type Filter

name: koyo_forecast

answer.description: The tool's user-facing answer as Markdown or JSON text.
